title: Decoding the Rule Book: Extracting Hidden Moderation Criteria from Reddit Communities

bias_targets.methodology: Extracting and comparing lexical moderation score matrices (CriteriaMatrix) across 60 different Reddit communities to measure varying tolerance levels and disparate enforcement for identical text spans (e.g., differing thresholds for personal attacks and topical constraints).

Constructing a synthetic dataset of contextually neutral comments containing highly penalized keywords (e.g., 'mod' or 'moderator') to evaluate whether trained models over-flag texts based on specific lexical features regardless of actual intent.
